items.q: like Monk said once when he was here at the house and Nelly, his wife was talking to him.

ctx.x: You mentioned being around men all the time. You spent your whole life really in a man's world.

On his lap and in his world, yet I'm feminine. You know, some women they change their sex after they've been around men like that all the time, but being around men gave me, you know, like Monk said once when he was here at the house and Nelly, his wife was talking to him. He says, "I won't listen to silly women. Mary's the only woman I'll take any advice from." See, they taught me their trend of thought and their way of thinking.
